about: Spytify's duplicate key (internal/core/records.go trackKey): lower(trim(artist)) + U+001F + lower(trim(title)), with Go's strings.ToLower and strings.TrimSpace. The controller matches the Web API's artists[0].name and name against Spytify's index with it.

generator.how: expected = track_key(artist, title), and for web_cases web_track_key({artists, name}), both from prototype/probe.py, which mirror Go's rules (go_lower, go_trim). The recorded cases are every line of the prototype's recorded.jsonl; their artist and title were recovered from the probe run logs by file path.
cross_checks: Each recorded case's expected key equals spytify_index_key, the key Spytify itself wrote to its index.

rules: Trim: Go's unicode.IsSpace at both ends: \t \n \v \f \r, space, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000–U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000. Not U+001C–U+001F.
Lower: per rune, Unicode simple case mapping. U+0130 İ → i; Σ → σ everywhere (no final-sigma rule).
No normalization (no NFC), and nothing stripped from titles.
From the Web API: artist = artists[0].name, or '' when there are none; title = name.
